notes.title: Bugfixes
notes.content:
A few minor bugfixes:

- Fixed a bug with the timer in the racing mini game and the shopping card mini game
- Changed the music transition to be a little quicker

notes.title: Hotfix for "unjustified game losses"
notes.content:
Two of the new additions to our Mini Game gauntlet, had an issue with the in-game timer. This caused the in-game timer of those games to start, without the games being active, which resulted in a loss of the run. 

Both timer issues should be fixed now.

notes.title: A few Bugfixes
notes.content: Just a few bugfixes. Thanks @SirMegalodon for pointing them out :)

notes.title: Final Addition to the Mini Game Gauntlet!
notes.content: And here it is, the final addition to our collection of 16 Minigames. Apart from bug-fixes, there won´t be any content-updates in the near feature. The code-base has become a Frankenstein-themed mix of spaghetti code and reference errors, since I got a little bit lazy putting everything together - Lesson learned, but I hope I never have to touch this code again ...

notes.title: Final Release
notes.content:
It's finally happening...

The final release of Catastrophic Cat Command is just around the corner, thanks to the amazing work of my students in the Q2 MINT computer science course. Numerous project contributions were submitted, and four of them made it into the live version of CCC. One more contribution is still pending and will be added in a future patch.

Have fun trying it out!

Your CCC Dev Team:
Dr. Ews, Niklas, Helene, Elena, Till, Yara, Linus, Johanna

notes.title: CCC v 0.7 - Release of a New Mini Game
notes.content:
A new mini game has been added ([b]Codename: Maus Klatsche[/b]). The mini game is used as a guided tutorial for my students to learn how to implement new assets (like new mini games) into catastrophic cat command. 

The mini game is probably only live for a brief period of time until the guided tutorial is finished (which is most likely in early december). 

Enjoy while it lasts!

notes.title: Removed FPS dependency in 3 Mini-Games
notes.content:
- Rocket velocity in planet mini-game was set to a constant velocity
- Removed FPS dependency of rotation in heat-shield mini-game
- Removed FPS dependency of rotation in parachute mini-game

All three games might feel slightly different now, if you were not playing at a constant 60 FPS.

notes.title: Small Bugfix
notes.content: Fixed a small Bug, that caused the menue screen after a game reset to stay visible

notes.title: Small Credits Update (v 0.59)
notes.content:
A small update regarding the credits screen to accommodate more entries - the new school year has started and the first developement cycle with students has begun. 

All deserve a spot on the credits screen :)

notes.title: Minor Gameplay Tweaks
notes.content:
[h1]Minor Gameplay Tweaks[/h1]

[list]
[*] The sky-diver game wont launch in unfair conditions (e.g. too much wind)
[*] The car game prompts for "Drive" and "Stop" have been increased in size
[*] Panels now spawn with a 1s delay
[/list]

notes.title: Catastrophic Cat Command - Tutorial live!
notes.content:
[h1]Tutorial live for Catastrophic Cat Command![/h1]

[list]
[*] The game now features a brief tutorial at the beginning of the game
[*] The game renderer was switched from Vulcan to OpenGL to increase compatability.
[/list]
